title: コンセプチュアル思考
subtitle: Conceptual Thinking
courseType: （全課程からの提供）リベラルアーツ系科目文理横断
educationalGoal:
学習・教育目標
The objective of this course is to acquire a way of thinking that enables students
 to grasp the essence of things and problems, and to think about solutions from
multiple perspectives. Students will learn methodologies that enable them to think
 and act while gaining insight into the hidden things latent in problems, judging
their value, and conceptualizing the whole issue.
advice:
In situations where planning, designing, problem solving, etc. are required, students will learn about thinking
activities that generate concepts, meanings, and values. These techniques include perceiving events structurally
 and conceptually, "seeing the essence" of matters, "thinking about combinations", and "creating new solutions".
Through lectures, exercises, and group work, students will deepen their understanding of the basic processes and
 models of conceptual thinking.

Students are expected to actively engage in class assignments and group work.

activityGoals.body: Understand the thinking process of capturing and conceptualizing the essence of a problem.
Structure the mechanisms and relationships of things and express them as meaningful information.
Understand methods for creating solutions from multiple perspectives.
Explain the difference between purposes, goals, and means through assigning meanings and values to things.
Understand the characteristics of various ways of thinking and utilize them in appropriate situations.

achievementLevels.ideal:
Based on the concept of conceptual thinking,
students are able to capture the essence of a
problem, uncover its meaning, and create
a new path to value creation.
achievementLevels.standard:
Students are able to explain the basic stance,
thinking process, and problem-solving techniques
of conceptual thinking.

lessons.content:
Guidance

Introduction to Conceptual Thinking
Seeing things in abstract and concrete terms

Understanding various thinking models 1

Logical/critical thinking
Design Thinking
Art Thinking

Understanding various thinking models 2

Logical/critical thinking
Design Thinking
Art Thinking

Understanding various thinking models3

Logical/critical thinking
Design Thinking
Art Thinking

Identifying and modeling the essence of
the problem

Viewing a given problem conceptually,
structurally, and intuitively

Idea generation 1

To grasp the essence of the problem and
create a solution using the items of
the 6th session.
Idea generation method (SCAMPER)

Idea Generation 2

Improve the solution ideas generated in
the 7th session.

Value Proposition 1

Create value propositions in terms of Need,
Approach, Benefit per Cost, and Competition
for the solutions considered in the 8th
session.

Value Proposition 2

Improve the value proposition considered in
the 9th session.

Value Proposition 3

Find meaning in things, visualize meaning
as a form that can be shared.
Present the value proposition and receive
feedback.

Group Project 1

Create an Elevator Pitch using NABC

Group Project 2

Improve the Elevator Pitch using NABC

Group Project 3

Present the elevator pitch using NABC
